63.
(1) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any
other  written  law,  the  Central  Bank  shall  be  exclusively
responsible  for  the  resolution  of  financial  institutions
provided that there is no material risk to public funds arising
(2)  The  Central  Bank  may  enter  into  agreements  with
foreign  supervisors  and  resolution  authorities  for  the
exchange  of  information  and  cooperation  in  resolution
planning and in the implementation of resolution measures.
(3) The Central Bank may exercise supervisory authority
specified in section 62 to carry out resolution planning and
implement resolution measures on financial institutions.
